items.title: File Widerspruch against the benefit amount
items.quote: Einen Widerspruch reichen Sie bitte binnen Monatsfrist nach Bekanntgabe ein, und zwar schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Landkreis Musterhöhe – Jugendamt, Kreishausstraße 1, 61169 Beispielberg.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 15.09.2025 (posting day). As a social-law authority letter sent by ordinary post, it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X): Fri 19.09.2025. Under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB (via § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X) the one-month Widerspruchsfrist starts the next day and ends one month later on the same calendar day, i.e. Sun 19.10.2025. Since that is a Sunday, § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X shifts the deadline to the next working day: Mon 20.10.2025.

items.title: Notify Jugendamt of changes affecting entitlement (child moving out, marriage, other parent paying maintenance)
items.quote: Teilen Sie uns bitte unverzüglich mit, wenn Mila nicht mehr bei Ihnen lebt, wenn Sie heiraten oder wenn der andere Elternteil Unterhalt zahlt.
items.computation: The letter requires notification 'unverzüglich' (without undue delay) whenever one of the listed events occurs. No calendar date can be set in advance because it depends on a future event that has not yet happened; German law treats 'unverzüglich' as 'without culpable delay', not a fixed number of days.

warnings: The 'unverzüglich' notification duty has no fixed calendar deadline in the letter; the exact day it must be reported depends on when the triggering event (e.g. Mila moving out) actually occurs.
